error: ImagePullBackOff Failed to pull image container image not found
root_cause: Incorrect Docker image repository or image tag configured in the Kubernetes deployment.
resolution: Verified the image in the container registry, corrected the image repository and tag, and restarted the deployment.

error: CrashLoopBackOff container repeatedly restarting application failed during startup
root_cause: The application container was crashing during startup because of incorrect configuration or missing environment variables.
resolution: Checked kubectl logs, corrected the application environment variables and redeployed the workload.

error: Docker push denied requested access to the resource is denied authentication failed
root_cause: The CI pipeline did not have valid container registry credentials.
resolution: Updated the registry credentials stored in GitHub Secrets and reran the pipeline.

error: ArgoCD application OutOfSync deployment image tag not updated
root_cause: The Kubernetes manifest contained an outdated container image tag.
resolution: Updated the image tag in the Helm values file and synchronized the ArgoCD application.

error: AccessDenied User is not authorized to perform operation insufficient IAM permissions
root_cause: The IAM role attached to the workload did not contain the required permissions.
resolution: Identified the denied AWS action, updated the IAM policy with the required permission and retried the operation.

error: Jenkins pipeline build failed command not found docker permission denied
root_cause: The Jenkins execution environment did not have access to the required Docker executable or permissions.
resolution: Configured Docker on the Jenkins agent, granted the required permissions and restarted the pipeline.

error: Pending pod insufficient cpu insufficient memory failed scheduling
root_cause: The Kubernetes cluster did not have enough available resources to satisfy the pod resource requests.
resolution: Reviewed pod requests and limits and increased cluster capacity before rescheduling the workload.

error: SSM managed instance not available instance not showing in systems manager
root_cause: The EC2 instance did not have the required Systems Manager IAM permissions or working SSM agent.
resolution: Attached AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore to the EC2 IAM role, verified the SSM agent and re-registered the instance.
